note: Two orthogonal axes. `narratives` describes WHAT is being discussed and applies to community posts and our own posts alike - it is the join key between the two. `layers` describes WHY we published and applies only to our own posts. Education is a layer, not a narrative.

narratives.label: Validators & MNOs
narratives.notes: Validator NAMES are never published - the Association will not announce them. Listening on this narrative is unrestricted; publishing is constrained.

narratives.label: Network & Protocol
narratives.notes: Absorbs the former standalone `layerzero` tag. Bridge and cross-chain discussion is protocol discussion; splitting it produced a near-empty series.

narratives.label: The Association
narratives.notes: The Association as an institution, distinct from any single governance action.

narratives.label: Price & Markets
narratives.listen_only_reason: Standing rule: @telcoinTAO does not comment on price action, market cap, or price vs. fundamentals. Tracked for listening only.

narratives.label: Banking & Stablecoin
narratives.listen_only_reason: Entity boundary: TDAB and eUSD product content is Telcoin Holdings, not Association. No public posts without explicit user instruction.

narratives.label: Other
narratives.listen_only_reason: Required catch-all so no observed post is silently dropped. A rising `other` count means the taxonomy needs a new narrative - review it.

layers.label: Governance
layers.notes: Tier 1 council notices, votes, agendas. Reach matters more than engagement; no conversation prompts.

layers.label: Education
layers.notes: Learning Path posts and explanatory threads. LP series content lives here, tagged with whatever narrative it explains.

rules.multi_tag: A post may carry more than one narrative. Count it once per narrative it genuinely discusses; do not spread fractional credit.
rules.catch_all: Every observed post must land on at least one narrative. If none fits, use `other` - never drop the post.
rules.publishable_false: Narratives with publishable:false render greyed with a listen-only marker and are excluded from every coverage-gap recommendation. Tracking what the community says is legitimate; recommending we publish into it is not.
rules.layer_scope: `layer` is set only on our own posts. Community posts carry narratives and no layer.
rules.adding_a_narrative: Add here first, then backfill is optional - never invent history. Set `since` to the date the narrative starts being tracked so the dashboard can render an honest start line.
